title: Saltglass Vigil
provenance: Wholly synthetic story architecture created for Novel Agent Harness book-scale evaluation. It contains no user manuscript or copied novel text.
premise: During an eight-day storm vigil in the lock-city of Veyru, a precise junior surveyor and a disgraced bell courier uncover different halves of a suppressed structural failure. To keep the seaward lock from killing the lower wards, they must distinguish sabotage from desperate truth-telling, expose an institution without destroying public trust, and coordinate a repair that neither can understand alone.

povs.name: Neris Aul
povs.voice: Measured, spatially exact, and syntactically complete. Notices load, distance, alignment, temperature, and the cost of uncertainty before faces.
constraints: Use cartographic or mechanical comparisons only when Neris would know the underlying mechanism.
Render fear through checking, counting, jaw tension, or recalibration until chapter 11.
Avoid casual slang, rhetorical questions, and unexplained certainty.
Her later voice may admit uncertainty but must not become lyrical or impulsive.

povs.name: Tovan Rusk
povs.voice: Oral, people-first, and rhythmically uneven. Notices voices, bargains, silences, and exits; uses dry humor to test whether a room is safe.
constraints: Mix short declarative lines with longer accumulative sentences and occasional rhetorical questions.
Use bell, song, crowd, or debt comparisons more often than visual geometry.
Tideworker cant may appear in dialogue or thought, but never as decorative dialect spelling.
Tovan must misuse or paraphrase technical map language unless quoting Neris.

characters.name: Neris Aul
characters.desire: Prove that exact records can protect people without requiring political judgment.
characters.fear: That uncertainty makes her as unreliable as her vanished father.
characters.secret: She altered a harmless calibration total as a student to protect Orra from an audit.
characters.arc: Learns that honest uncertainty and accountable choice are more trustworthy than immaculate-looking records.

characters.name: Tovan Rusk
characters.desire: Keep his younger sibling Cael alive without owing any institution obedience.
characters.fear: That truth is merely another lever powerful people use on the exposed.
characters.secret: He still possesses a retired master bell-key and answers to the old courier alias Merrin.
characters.arc: Moves from protective concealment to consent-based disclosure and shared responsibility.

characters.name: Orra Pell
characters.role: director of the Silt Archive and Neris's mentor
characters.desire: Preserve the lock service long enough to repair it without a lethal panic.
characters.fear: Public knowledge arriving before public coordination.
characters.secret: She suppressed two pressure deviations and plans an unannounced partial evacuation.
characters.arc: Accepts external scrutiny after her paternal secrecy becomes part of the danger.

characters.name: Cael Rusk
characters.role: glass polisher and member of the Low Choir
characters.desire: Force the council to acknowledge lower-ward risk before the Vigil.
characters.fear: That gradual reform is a polite name for preventable deaths.
characters.secret: They copied, but did not steal, the red pressure ledger and staged the archive break-in.
characters.arc: Learns to separate urgency from unilateral control while retaining justified anger.

characters.name: Yara Aul
characters.role: Neris's aunt, lower-ward brine physician, and former courier
characters.desire: Keep the clinic functioning through the Vigil.
characters.fear: Losing Neris to the same institutional loyalty that consumed Neris's father.
characters.secret: She knows Tovan's old alias and the true circumstances of Hal Aul's disappearance.
characters.arc: Stops rationing family history as if truth were medicine.

characters.name: Janek Voss
characters.desire: Complete his last Vigil without the city hearing his injured hand fail.
characters.fear: Being replaced before he can train Pel in the emergency codes.
characters.secret: His grip fails intermittently, so the seventh bell sometimes doubles in the west arcade.
characters.arc: Chooses a visible accommodation over a dangerous performance of competence.

characters.name: Sera Nymm
characters.role: lock engineer responsible for the seaward bearings
characters.desire: Secure one low-tide maintenance window before the king tide.
characters.fear: Being blamed for iron crazing caused by the council's procurement shortcut.
characters.secret: She found iron filings in the bearing housings and hid a sample in a medicine vial.
characters.arc: Moves from defensive expertise to legible, shared evidence.

characters.name: Pel Anik
characters.role: teenage market runner and apprentice bellkeeper
characters.desire: Earn a permanent tower place rather than being treated as an errand child.
characters.fear: That admitting a missed message will end the apprenticeship.
characters.secret: Pel delivered Orra's evacuation draft one hour late after helping at a ferry collision.
characters.arc: Confesses the delay and becomes the clearest communicator during the emergency.

characters.name: Issa Dar
characters.role: council comptroller and public face of the Vigil
characters.desire: Prevent a run on the upper gates while keeping trade open.
characters.fear: A true warning delivered badly will kill more people than the lock failure.
characters.secret: Issa approved cheaper iron-shod service carts after being shown incomplete risk tables.
characters.arc: Accepts responsibility publicly without falsely claiming sole causation.

locations.name: Silt Archive
locations.geometry: Terraced record rooms above the inner lock; one public stair and one floodable service descent.

locations.name: Lower Wards
locations.geometry: Clinic lanes and brine kilns below the second flood line, connected by raised blue walks.

locations.name: Seaward Lock
locations.geometry: Twin gates, three bearing galleries, a west inspection cradle, and a tide-limited underpass.

locations.name: Nine Bellhouse
locations.geometry: Central tower with east and west arcades whose echoes reach different districts.

locations.name: Lantern Market
locations.geometry: Covered market bridging the archive hill and lower wards; shutters turn aisles into evacuation lanes.

locations.name: North Ferry Steps
locations.geometry: Tidal landing outside the inner gate, inaccessible for forty minutes around high water.

objects.name: Cracked saltglass survey lens
objects.consequence: Reveals pressure memory only when oriented with its maker's notch seaward; reversing it mirrors the crack.

objects.name: Red pressure ledger
objects.consequence: Contains handwritten deviations and a deliberately removed blank folio; Cael's copy lacks indentation evidence.

objects.name: Retired master bell-key
objects.consequence: Can unlock the manual code carriage but cannot itself sound a bell.

objects.name: Blue ceramic ferry token
objects.consequence: Its civic-year stamp proves a disputed trip only if converted from the harbor calendar.

objects.name: Medicine vial of iron filings
objects.consequence: Links bearing damage to service carts but not to the person who authorized them.

objects.name: Pel's knotted message cord
objects.consequence: Preserves message order and delay intervals without revealing message content.

worldRules.rule: Fresh saltglass records the greatest pressure applied since its last kiln reset; reheating erases the prior record.
A survey lens must face its maker's notch seaward or its stress image is laterally mirrored.
The seaward bearings can be unloaded only while the tide is below the blue mark, for at most seventy minutes.
The archive service descent becomes one-way toward the lower wards once the inner float rises.
Repeated vibration from iron-shod loads causes charged saltglass to craze; ordinary hand tools do not.
Emergency bell meaning depends on count, pause, and arcade; echoes may add an audible strike without changing the sent code.
Veyru's civic year begins at the first neap tide after winter, eleven days later than the mainland year in this story.
Opening the upper evacuation gates before market shutters lock creates a counterflow that blocks the lower blue walks.

rescue without consent to honest loyalty with boundaries

chapters.summary: Neris records a forked stress image in a routine Vigil survey, then discovers that the clean archive copy omits the fluctuation her lens retains.
chapters.intent: Establish her exactness, the lock stakes, the mirrored-lens uncertainty, and her trust in Orra.
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows the official record and physical trace disagree.

chapters.summary: Tovan intercepts Cael after a staged archive break-in and hears a seven-strike warning that the west arcade makes sound like eight.
chapters.intent: Establish courier hearing, sibling conflict, the Merrin alias, and an apparent bell-count contradiction.
knowledgeChanges: Tovan knows Cael copied evidence and plans a public warning.

chapters.summary: Orra assigns Neris to disprove sabotage rumors; comparison of binding holes shows the ledger's absent folio was removed while blank.
chapters.intent: Complicate the easy theft theory and introduce the safe evacuation bell sequence.
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows the missing page does not itself prove suppression.

chapters.summary: Yara hires Tovan to bring Neris a ferry token tied to Hal Aul, while Cael admits staging entry but denies touching the lock.
chapters.intent: Bind family mystery to present risk and make Tovan choose partial cooperation over flight.
knowledgeChanges: Tovan learns Neris once protected Orra in an audit.

chapters.summary: Neris and Sera inspect the bearings during low tide; a clock gap prevents them from fixing the failure minute, and mirrored readings implicate the wrong gallery until Neris turns the lens.
chapters.intent: Demonstrate epistemic correction and establish the missing-minute dependency.
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows bearing damage is real but not whether sabotage or carts caused it.

chapters.summary: Tovan traces Pel's delayed message through knots rather than testimony and sees Janek hide a failed grip during rehearsal.
chapters.intent: Separate messenger failure from moral blame and set up the accommodation Janek resists.
knowledgeChanges: Tovan knows the warning delay had an innocent cause and Janek's performance is unsafe.

chapters.summary: Neris proves the lens crack predates Cael's break-in, confronts Orra, and receives a technically truthful denial that conceals the suppressed deviations.
chapters.intent: Pay off physical lens evidence while breaking Neris's trust without resolving Orra's motive.
setups: Neris's oath not to ring the bell
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows Orra is withholding something and admits her own old alteration to Tovan.

chapters.summary: Tovan converts the token's civic date, finds a ferryman who remembers Hal, and learns the red copy cannot show which entries pressed through later pages.
chapters.intent: Pay off the token and ledger-copy limitations; expose Tovan's alias to Neris.
knowledgeChanges: Neris learns Tovan is Merrin; Tovan learns Hal left after documenting a deviation.

chapters.summary: Neris reconstructs the split-arcade warning and models a safe sequence: close market shutters, clear blue walks, then sound three-pause-three.
chapters.intent: Turn scattered facts into an actionable but still uncertain plan.
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows an early undirected alarm is itself hazardous.

chapters.summary: Tovan assembles retired couriers to route a quiet pre-warning, but refuses Cael's demand to seize the bell carriage before the market is prepared.
chapters.intent: Pay off his people network and force a consent boundary with Cael.
knowledgeChanges: Cael learns Tovan will not equate loyalty with obedience.

chapters.summary: Hal's map and Sera's vial connect iron-shod carts to progressive crazing; Orra reveals her partial evacuation plan, and Neris states the unresolved timing range aloud.
chapters.intent: Resolve cause without inventing a single villain and complete Neris's first honest uncertainty turn.
knowledgeChanges: Neris knows the likely cause and Orra's motive; Issa learns the tables she saw were incomplete.

chapters.summary: A rehearsal reveals the missing clock minute in the bellhouse maintenance roll; Tovan gives Neris the master key only after they agree who may halt the sequence.
chapters.intent: Pay off partnership trust, the missing minute, and Janek's concealed disability through an operational agreement.
knowledgeChanges: The core group shares the safe sequence and the limits of each person's authority.

chapters.summary: As the king tide rises, Neris publishes the evidence ledger with confidence ranges, Orra submits to oversight, and the team begins the bearing unload while Cael disappears toward the tower.
chapters.intent: Complete the accountability arcs while tightening the physical emergency.
knowledgeChanges: The public knows enough to act safely but not every private family fact.

chapters.summary: Tovan finds Cael at the carriage, shares the abort condition, and lets them choose to wait; Pel sounds the split-arcade warning after shutters close, the bearing is unloaded, and Tovan releases the key rather than keeping a private lever.
chapters.intent: Resolve the lock crisis through coordinated authority, not solitary heroics, while leaving institutional and family futures open.
knowledgeChanges: Cael understands the delay and consents; the city learns the repair sequence succeeded within a stated range.

dependencies.constraint: The crack must predate the break-in and mirror when reversed.
The copy proves content but cannot preserve indentation evidence.
Count, pause, and arcade jointly determine the warning.
Convert the civic stamp before using it to date Hal's trip.
The failure time remains a range until the bellhouse roll supplies the missing minute.
Cart scars plus filings support progressive vibration damage, not intentional sabotage.
Neris promised not to ring the bell herself, not to prohibit an authorized warning.
Tovan's retired courier ties become useful only after he asks rather than commands.
Hal's notation enables honest uncertainty rather than a perfectly exact answer.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Tovan hears eight strikes where Neris's record says seven.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: The west arcade echo adds an audible strike; both perceptions are honest.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: The lens crack appears on opposite sides in two inspections.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: The lens was reversed; the stress image mirrors under the orientation rule.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Yara calls Tovan Merrin without explanation.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: Merrin is Tovan's retired courier alias, not a mistaken identity.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: The ferry token appears dated eleven days in the future.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: The civic and mainland years begin on different dates.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: A numbered ledger folio is missing.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: It was removed blank during binding and is not the suppressed evidence.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Cael says they never entered the Archive but admits staging the break-in.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: Cael opened the outer grille and remained in the threshold while an accomplice copied the ledger.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Pel arrives wet despite the north ferry being tide-closed.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: Pel crossed a leaking brine-kiln lane, not the ferry.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Janek uses his injured hand successfully in one scene and fails in another.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: The grip impairment is intermittent and worsens with repeated load.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Orra says 'we corrected the figures' although no co-conspirator is named.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: Her institutional 'we' diffuses responsibility; it does not prove a secret group.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Smoke is smelled in the lower wards although no fire alarm sounds.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: The odor comes from normal brine kilns restarting after rain.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Two characters place a meeting 'before dawn' on different calendar days.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: One speaks before sleeping and one after midnight; the meeting time itself is consistent.

intentionalAmbiguities.apparent: Neris promises not to ring the bell but helps initiate the warning.
intentionalAmbiguities.authorIntent: She does not strike or order it; she supplies evidence and an abort condition to the authorized bellkeepers.

variantDefects.mutation: Change the ferry token from blue ceramic to brass despite earlier and later handling evidence.
State that the red ledger retains pressure indentations although only Cael's flat copy is present.
Place king tide on day 6 rather than day 8 without changing the countdown.
Have Tovan use the recovered clock minute before Pel reveals the maintenance roll.
Let Neris climb the flooded service descent back into the Archive after the float rises.
Move from west arcade to seaward bearing gallery in one minute despite the established route.
Claim ordinary iron hand tools caused the crazing rather than repeated cart vibration.
Treat opening upper gates early as a way to clear, rather than block, the lower blue walks.
Have Tovan cheerfully endorse Cael's carriage seizure immediately after setting a consent boundary.
Have Neris feel no conflict about publishing Orra's suppression after their mentor bond breaks.
Let Tovan identify the lens orientation error before Neris tells him or demonstrates it.
Let Cael know Janek's intermittent grip before anyone outside Tovan and Janek has observed it.
Give Neris slang-heavy fragments and a decorative song metaphor during confrontation.
Give Tovan exact unexplained bearing tolerances and Neris's geometric internal diction.

frozenDecisions: Canonical prose will contain no planted defects; every defect is an isolated patch with source preconditions.
Orra is culpable for suppression but is not the sole cause of the lock failure.
Cael stages the archive entry but does not damage the lock.
The repair succeeds through coordinated bounded authority; no single protagonist performs every critical action.
Hal Aul remains alive but off-page, and whether he returns remains unresolved.
The Neris-Tovan relationship resolves as earned operational trust, not mandatory romance.
Intentional ambiguities remain unresolved or explainable without being continuity errors.
Public disclosure excludes private facts that are unnecessary for safe collective action.
